input-field.name: enabled
input-field.label: Enable customer wallet
启用客户储值钱包
input-field.helpText: When enabled, administrators can top up a customer wallet and customers can pay part of the order total from their wallet balance.
开启后，管理员可为客户钱包充值，顾客可在结算时使用钱包余额抵扣部分订单金额。

input-field.name: minTopUpAmount
input-field.label: Minimum top-up amount
最低充值金额
input-field.helpText: A top-up is rejected when the credited amount is lower than this value.
单次充值金额低于该数值时将被拒绝。

input-field.name: maxPaymentPercent
input-field.label: Maximum share of the order total payable with wallet balance (in %)
钱包最多抵扣订单金额的百分比
input-field.helpText: Limits how much of the order total may be covered by the wallet balance. Use 100 to allow paying the full order with the wallet.
限制钱包余额可抵扣的订单金额上限。填写 100 表示允许全额抵扣。

input-field.name: maxTopUpAmount
input-field.label: Maximum online top-up amount
单笔在线充值上限
input-field.helpText: An online top-up above this value is rejected. Use 0 to allow any amount.
在线充值金额高于该数值时将被拒绝。填写 0 表示不限制。

input-field.name: topUpPresets
input-field.label: Suggested top-up amounts
充值金额快捷档位
input-field.helpText: Comma separated amounts the storefront offers next to the free input, e.g. 100,200,500.
门店前台在自定义金额之外展示的快捷档位，多个金额用英文逗号分隔，例如 100,200,500。
